Initial state was within limits, so violation was produced by controller on first control step

counterfactual.change: Raised force_limit from 40 to 80 with all else identical; the same 41.64 force is then within limit so no violation

explanation: Controller gain adaptation produces ~41.6 force on first step for this plant/initial state (heavy cart 2kg, theta 0.1, omega 0.3) but fails to clip to scenario force_limit 40, violating controller_force_limit at step 1.
vision_note: The cart stays centered between the walls and the pole remains nearly upright from step 0 through step 4. There is no visible fall, excursion, or red-highlighted body, with all frames looking essentially identical.
